name: timepicker
title: Timepicker
description: Materialize's clock-dial time picker in a modal, with keyboard spinbuttons, localized AM/PM and an HH:mm value.
improvements: Keyboard and screen-reader support: hour and minute spinbuttons (arrows, PageUp/PageDown, typed digits) and a focusable dial.
Pointer Events drag on the dial for mouse, touch and pen, snapping to the minute step.
Localized AM/PM labels and a 12/24-hour default taken from the locale's hour cycle.
minTime, maxTime and step are enforced on the dial, the spinbuttons and typed input.
onOpenChange fires on every close path, and vibration only happens when you opt in.
